title: MAXlig - Preparing ligand with U in primer flanks
body:
### 1. MAXlig - Preparing ligand with U in primer flanks

Dilute 1 uL of the oligo to 50 uL total using TE buffer (~60 ng/uL).

Set up 2X reactions:

Amplification PCR: 15X

For each reaction (25 uL)


| Reagent | Volume |
| :---- | :---- |
| repliQa HiFi ToughMix (2X) | 12.5 uL |
| DAFs_U_F 10 uM | 0.75 uL |
| DAFs_U_R 10 uM | 0.75 uL |
| MAXlig | 2 uL |
| NF water | 9 uL |
